remove_note: No C0 component is deleted. Fuselage_Pod is rebuilt as a shorter forebody (see modify). C0 wire W15 is replaced by the longer W15x.

modify.change: REV 2: forebody to the joint plane s=0.7267 m: elliptic nose a=0.220 m to R=0.080 m, cylinder to s=0.500 m, then the first 0.2267 m of the spec tail-cone law r=0.030+0.050(1-u^2(3-2u)), u=s_c/0.450 (end radius 0.0547 m), flat disc at the joint plane with an 8 mm spigot seat (r 50 mm). modify.change: Translate every pod-fixed component forward by DX = +0.0167 m along +X (re-register the pod on the wing saddle so the CG returns to 28 % MAC). Wing, saddle, spar, joiner, booms, lift motors/props, gear, H-tail, fins, pitot, airspeed module ASPD1 and joint boxes JB_* do NOT move.

modify.target: J-11 hardware (HW-034..HW-040 + any other J-11 piece)

Slip fit 0.4 mm radial (sleeve ID 130.8 vs tongue OD 130.0), EST. Screws now at x=-0.2710 m, r~53 mm; the joint is 21 mm aft of the wing saddle, so no wing cut-out is needed.

rev2_note: Rev 2 (2026-11-03): joint plane moved from x=-0.0333 m (inside the wing chord x -0.239..0) to x=-0.2600 m, 21 mm aft of the saddle / J-01 root plates / J-02 hard-points (aft extent x=-0.239 m measured in Fusion).
